description: This is a Python source file for a Streamlit-based web application that implements a chatbot interface integrated with a SQL database using LangChain and OpenAI APIs. It sets up database connections, defines tools and prompts for interacting with the database, and manages user interactions and responses.

methods.name: greeting_input
methods.description: Returns a greeting response, used as a tool before other tools.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: Runs a prompt through the language model to process user queries, measuring token usage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main Streamlit app function that manages user interaction, message display, and query processing.
